facility.name: Fisher Kids Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 742 S BENTSEN PALM DR, MISSION, TX, 78572

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Six staff files were reviewed: six files are missing pre-employment affidavit (form 2912) and  one file is missing notarized affidavit (form 2985 and orientation / center - personnel personnel policies statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: Two out of six staff files reviewed have invalid high school diplomas.     Note: Provider submitted a variance request on 10/14/2025 for one of the caregivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The Children's Safety Products Certification was last signed on 01/10/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: Last gas leak inspection was conducted on 12/02/2022.     Note: provider contacted and schedule a gas leak inspection during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Two out of eight bucket seats within a kidney table are missing safety straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: The most recent fire / health  inspections were not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver was in charge of supervising a group of five children ages 8mo, 10mo, 10mo, 12mo and 12mo. Classroom by over ratio by one child.     Note: This was corrected when one of the children left operation, leaving caregiver in charge of four infant-age children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The seat to a child sized toilet was broken off in a children's restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Floor Plan: The emergency evacuation and relocation diagram did not inlcude two exit paths from each room that did not open directly to the outdoors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Floor Plan (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: The emergency practices form available for review was not maintained.There was no safety documentation for fire drills practiced for the month of June 2024. There was no documentation available for fire extinguishers checks, smoke detectors checks, and carbon monoxide detector checks conducted for the months of May, and June 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: An infant was combined with a group of older children of varying ages during naptime in a school-aged area. There were a total of 15 children in the group and the ages of the children included toddlers, pre-k, and school aged children. The infant was 9 months of age and the oldest chlid in the group was 9 years of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: A group of toddler children did not wash their hands before eating their afternoon snack.         Note: This was addressed with the director and children were taken to wash their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The air conditioner was not maintained and was leaking water into a toddler room floor. This posed a slipping hazard for children and staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System: The sign in and out log was not maintained. A total of 16 children were in care and only 13 children were signed in.        Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the sign in sheet was updated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Tracking System (26 TAC §746.801(19))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The flush handle of a children's toilet was not working.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies reviewed were missing the following information:    Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity that is consistent with Subchapter F of this chapter (relating to Developmental Activities and Activity Plan); the policies must include:    (A) The benefits of physical activity and outdoor play;    (B) The duration of physical activity at your operation, both indoor and outdoor;    (C) The type of physical activity (structured and unstructured) that children may engage in at your operation;    (D) Each setting in which your physical activity program will take place;    (E) The recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physical activities; and    (F) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: Operation did not have complete operation policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: Fire extinguisher was not properly secured in transportation vehicle.     Corrected at inspection when director mounted fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident: Transportation vehicle had one expired booster seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §746.5607(b))

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: Operation did not have a carbon monoxide detection detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)
